messages.subject: Shiny constructing tree graphic with interactive nodes
parts:
Hi all,


I would like to make a shiny website which can interact with a tree graphic (see the tree below). I would like to have different plots appear based on the node that was clicked. The tree size and shape will be fixed. I tried using networkD3, but could not figure out how to make a nice binary tree and respond to the clicks.

I basically want each node to represent a toggle-able button which can be selected and result in a plot appearing.
Are there any packages to help me achieve this?


Thanks for your help!

Best,
D
